Judah's captivity is restored together with Jerusalem's.
Israel is God's people scattered among the nations.
Judah names the territory whose streams will flow with water.
Judah will remain inhabited forever, parallel to Jerusalem through the generations.
Amos's vision concerns Israel during the reigns of Uzziah and Jeroboam.
